Fleet.title: Work in a Great Car with Vonco Partners
Fleet.description: We are looking for drivers who love the road as much as we do. We have about 100 cars for every taste: from reliable workhorses like the **Skoda Fabia** to comfortable **Toyota Camry**, **Lexus**, and even **Tesla**. Most cars are modern hybrids to help you spend less on fuel and earn more.
Fleet.incomeNote: With us, you can take home up to **55% of the revenue**. Everything is transparent and fair.
Fleet.flexibility: Rent a car yourself or share it with a partner to save money. We adjust the schedule to fit you—perfect for students or as a side job.

cards.rentDesc: Take a car for work and personal use. No hidden mileage limits.
cards.shiftDesc: Work whenever it's convenient: day, night, or only on weekends. You are your own boss.
cards.doubleDesc: Share a car with a friend and work in shifts. It's more profitable for both.

footerBox.title: Want to Join Our Team?
footerBox.text: We provide cars in Krakow and Zakopane. If you are from another city—no problem, we can help you become a driver with your own car and connect you to Vonco's profitable settlements.

FleetInfo.title: Work as a Driver with Vonco Partners
FleetInfo.description1: We cooperate with taxi service drivers and provide modern cars for work and daily use.
FleetInfo.description2: Our fleet includes about 100 cars of various classes: Toyota Prius (various models), Corolla, Camry, Lexus, Tesla, Skoda Fabia, and Superb.
